# Infinity Renewal - Registration Life shows 180 days under History

_Category: Report an Issue · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**chelsea.hansen** (3/17/2022):

In the Sandbox API.
When submitting a renewal with lifeInfinite set to true, so an infinite renewal.
Under History of the PDF Verification statement Registration Life states 180 Days which would be incorrect.
Expirations date and time reflects correctly at "Never"
